text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Common Gaming Houses (Casino Operators — Exemption) Notification 2010 and shall come into operation on 12th February 2010.
2. In this Notification, unless the context otherwise requires, “casino operator”, “casino premises” and “game” have the same meanings as in section 2(1) of the Casino Control Act (Cap. 33A).

3. The provisions of the Act do not apply to and in relation to any gaming, or lottery held, within the casino premises of a casino operator, if the game or lottery is conducted —
(a)by or on behalf of the casino operator; or
(b)under the control or supervision of the casino operator.
[S 6/2019 wef 03/01/2019]
